behaviors_asserted: Each sibling file (except the index/mod file) has a sole named export of type Hono.
The index/mod file re-exports each of its sibling modules (using export *).
Provide a utility (instance method like new Hono().fromLookup(routes) or static Hono.fromLookup(routes)) that merges an object of exported Hono instances into a single Hono router.
Iterating over routes and attaching their values to a Hono instance currently merges them but does not preserve type information for use by the Hono client.
